name: 46804 · Fort Wayne, IN
findings: ZIP 46804 (Fort Wayne) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46804 (Fort Wayne) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46804 (Fort Wayne) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.
